location_refs._rule: A location that is VISIBLE anywhere in a segment (even through a door or window) must have its reference attached (lint L2).

locks.STYLE: ONE UNBROKEN CONTINUOUS SHOT, first frame to last: a single take with no cuts. One smooth gimbal camera keeps the airplane in view. Photorealistic live action, 16:9.
locks.PLANE: The airplane is the plain white dart from the airplane reference: crisply, completely folded from blank A4 (no print, no logo), long sharp nose, two flat identical swept-back wings, sharp creases, neat keel, never crumpled or half-folded. It flies nose first on one smooth continuous path, never jumps, flips or reverses, turns only in slow gentle curves, and never changes shape or size.
locks.LIGHT: Sunny late morning, same warm sunlight direction throughout, no flicker.
locks.classroom: Classroom = the classroom in the start image: ivory walls, green chalkboard in front, light-wood desks, windows with white blinds on the LEFT wall; the sliding door at the FRONT-RIGHT is wide open from the first frame to the moment the airplane leaves.
locks.corridor: Corridor = corridor reference, ONE single straight corridor whose design and exposure never change, the same through the door and inside: glossy light-grey floor with sunlight stripes, tall windows facing the sports field on one side, ivory wall with doors on the other, evenly lit, never blown-out white.
locks.field: Field = the field reference: the same dirt field, white lines, soccer goals in the same positions, green trees, ivory school building, clear blue sky. Students are always small, seen from high above or behind, no recognisable faces.
locks.sky: Clear deep blue sky above the same school.
locks.venue: Festival ground = the two festival references, identical layout: a natural green GRASS soccer pitch with striped mowing and white lines inside a red running track; at the FAR end the festival stage with a white truss roof and white tents on both sides; four blocks of black chairs in front of the stage; a small black sound booth in the centre circle; long rows of white booth tents along both sides of the track; the green inflatable air arch standing at the track gate on the NEAR curve, not on the grass; outside the track, nearest the school: in front of the arch a road, then a wide open lawn block, then the paved lot with SIX colourful food trucks in one straight row and the yellow parasol tables below them (school side); a straight road runs from the junction in front of the arch toward the school between that lot and a plain lawn; only one goal at the near end of the pitch; a bus and trucks on the road; red, green and orange bean bags ONLY on the lawn between the near-right curve of the track and the road where the bus and trucks are parked (track side of that road, just right of the arch); the lawn on the school side of that road is plain grass; green trees and apartment blocks behind. The festival is busy and joyful: hundreds of students fill the ground, browsing and chatting at the booth tents, queuing and eating at the food trucks and parasol tables, lounging and laughing on the bean bags, posing for photos at the air arch, sitting together in the chair blocks and walking around in small groups; always small, seen from above or behind, no recognisable faces.

negatives_global: no teleporting, reversing or tail-first airplane
no text, subtitles, watermarks or logos
